thread:
sasha (marketing-ops): ok folks, we need a fresh webinar plan — aim: convert engineers -> product teams to try Redwood Dedicated. I sketched topics, want pick + run-of-show + lead routing.

maria (content): topics look good. i'm partial to "Operationalizing LLMs: reliability patterns that matter" — practical, low hype.

lin (product): agree. propose we center the narrative on a single canonical customer journey: prototype -> unexpected load -> automated fallback + SLA restore. keeps it concrete.

jamal (growth): audience target: infra + platform PMs. CTA should be "request capacity consult" for hot leads. we'll route >50 qps to AE.

kevin (eng): i'll show a short demo of smart routing + cache warming. live demo risky; propose 90s live + 90s recorded fallback clip.

sasha (marketing-ops): vote check: topic "Operationalizing LLMs" ✅ (lin, maria, kevin) — settled. speakers: Lin (product) + Kevin (eng), emcee Jamal, backup Maria for story.

maria (content): draft abstract: "Operationalizing LLMs: real patterns for reliability and cost control. We'll walk through routing, caching, and fallback strategies used to keep apps online under bursty traffic." bullets: who should attend, 3 takeaways, short case teaser.

lin (product): run-of-show suggestion: 00:00 Intro + problem framing (Jamal) 03:00 Product journey + objectives (Lin) 08:00 Demo: routing + cache (Kevin) 12:00 Case study: SLA recovery timeline (Lin + Maria) 18:00 Live Qs (panel) 26:00 Close CTA (Jamal). keeping it tight ~30m.

sasha (marketing-ops): logistical checklist: 1) record 2 demo variants (full recording + 30s highlight) 2) captions + Spanish localization 3) CDN-hosted fallback clip 4) rehearsal T-1 day + tech check 30m prior.

jamal (growth): lead form fields: company size, qps estimate, deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private). Routing: "dedicated-interest" tag + webhook to CRM. High-intent rule: qps > 50 OR "dedicated" selected -> AE queue. test webhook in staging by Mon.

kevin (eng): slide data: p95 vs p99 latency across cache hits, cost per 1m tokens with/without batching, and example routing policy rules. i'll upload CSV + sample trace images to assets by Fri EOD.

maria (content): social plan: 30s demo clip + 3 chart cards. headlines A/B: 1) "How we kept a chat feature online during a 10x spike" 2) "Designing LLM fallbacks that don't break UX" 3) "From prototype to SLA: routing, caching, and cost." i'll prep copy + visuals.

sasha (marketing-ops): rehearsal windows: Wed 9:00 PT or Thu 14:00 PT. which works for everyone?

kevin (eng): Wed morning good. prefer 9:00 PT.

lin (product): Wed works. add 30m tech check at 8:30 PT.

greenroom-bot: rehearsal reserved: Wed 09:00 PT - "Operationalizing LLMs" rehearsal. invites sent.

calendar-bot: promo cadence: T-21 days start, target 1000 regs, regen emails at T-10 and T-3.

jamal (growth): CRO test: two CTAs on thank-you page: 1) schedule consult 2) download benchmark kit. track which converts better.

maria (content): sales one-pager for AEs with 3 talking points + example customer quote. i'll share draft Tue morning.

sasha (marketing-ops): action items: lin: final slides + case timeline (due Mon); kevin: demo recordings + data CSV (due Fri); maria: abstract + social assets + AE one-pager (due Tue); jamal: promo plan + CRM webhook test (due Mon); sasha: book AV + localization + runbook (in progress).

kevin (eng): i'll also prepare a 30s "what failed and why" clip to make the failover trigger obvious.

lin (product): agreed — small explainer reduces confusion in Qs.

jamal (growth): tagging plan: add "operationalizing-llms-24" event tag and ensure GA + CRM capture utm. will share draft promo calendar.

maria (content): quick copy note: avoid too much jargon on promos. emphasize outcomes (availability, cost savings).

sasha (marketing-ops): perfect. we'll do a dry run Wed 08:30 PT, rehearsal 09:00 PT. I'll post final runbook here after rehearsal. thanks all :thumbsup:

greenroom-bot: rehearsal reminder set for Wed 08:30 PT.

sasha (marketing-ops): final CTA order for registration: 1) quick use-case survey + qps 2) request consult (AE) 3) access benchmark kit. that aligns with CRO tests?

jamal (growth): yes, aligns. I'll confirm webhook result on Mon and update thread.

lin (product): see you at the tech check.

maria (content): dropping the abstract and bios now.
